entries.title: Prison Architect
entries.definitive_edition: Prison Architect: Total Lockdown on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Prison Architect: Total Lockdown bundle route
primary.why: Prison Architect is available on desktop, console, and mobile platforms, but the Steam PC route exposes the deepest current content path, including major DLC and the Total Lockdown bundle. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. Windows PC is the preferred archive route for capture/settings, mod/Workshop-style preservation, and the clearest complete-content storefront path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC Steam release through the Total Lockdown bundle or equivalent owned DLC set. Use console/mobile versions only for comparison unless their DLC parity is separately rechecked.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with the clearest DLC bundle route and strongest capture/settings control.
all_releases.reason: primary: best complete-content and archive route.
secondary: content-valid desktop routes, but Windows PC remains the main capture target.

all_releases.fidelity: Console routes for adapted controller play.
all_releases.reason: secondary: useful couch routes, but DLC parity and capture/settings control are less clear than PC.
skip: convenience route with lower archive capture/control and less clear DLC parity than PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC has the strongest content and capture route; no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay advantage was found for console/mobile.

entries.remaster_caveats: Major DLC packs are expansion content for the original game. Prison Architect 2 is a separate sequel and should be tracked separately when it has a stable released route.
